product.name: ezRNA™ Platform
product.description: A platform that allows the incorporation of standard and non-standard nucleobases, as well as modifications to these nucleobases.

product.name: Standard and Phosphorothioated Backbones
product.description: The platform supports the installation of both standard and phosphorothioated backbones.

product.name: 2’- Modifications
product.description: The platform can incorporate all standard 2’- modifications essential for siRNA therapeutics and novel modifications.

product.name: 3’- Modifications
product.description: The platform provides access to 3’- modifications including linkers and chain terminators.
